code_examples.text:
when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
    set payload [UDP::payload]
    set t2 [GTP::parse $payload]
    set t3 [GTP::clone $t2]
    log local0. "GTP type [GTP::header type -message $t3]"
    log local0. "GTP teid [GTP::header teid -message $t3]"
}
